migration_flags.description: v19 uses odoo.fields.Domain class objects (Domain.AND, Domain.OR, Domain.TRUE, Domain.optimize) throughout ir_rule.py instead of raw Python lists. Code integrating with ir.rule must be updated to produce and consume Domain objects.

The assembled domain is passed through Domain.optimize(model) before return. This may change the shape of domains compared to v16/v17 where no optimization step existed, affecting downstream domain consumers.

Parent model rules for delegation-inherited models are wrapped using Domain(field, 'any', sub_domain). The 'any' operator is a v17+ domain extension. Custom models using _inherits must verify this operator is supported in their target environment.
_get_rules uses odoo.tools.SQL object for query construction rather than raw string formatting. Patches or overrides touching _get_rules must use SQL() not string interpolation.

The class-level _allow_sudo_commands = False attribute on ir.rule is present in v19. This restricts elevated-privilege ORM commands on rule records themselves. Custom code that previously modified ir.rule records via sudo() may need review.
Cache invalidation uses self.env.registry.clear_cache() (v17+ API). Code from v15/v16 using self.pool.clear_caches() is incompatible and must be updated.

key_findings.sudo_bypass: CONFIRMED UNCONDITIONAL — _get_rules() returns empty recordset when self.env.su is True (line 120-121); no ir.rule domains are applied to any model query executed under sudo()
key_findings.global_rule_logic: Global rules (no groups) are AND-ed together; each one can independently block access
key_findings.group_rule_logic: Group rules for the same or different groups are OR-ed; the combined OR must pass to grant access; then AND-ed with global rules
key_findings.eval_context_vars: Only three variables available in domain expressions: user (with empty context), company_ids (list), company_id (int)
key_findings.cache_key: Domain cache keyed on (uid, su, model_name, mode, tuple(allowed_company_ids))
key_findings.cache_invalidation: Full registry cache cleared on any create/write/unlink of ir.rule records
key_findings.multicompany_pattern: Standard pattern: [('company_id', 'in', company_ids)] using company_ids from _eval_context; error detection is string-match based
key_findings.inherits_support: Parent model rules propagated to child via Domain(delegation_field, 'any', parent_domain) — treated as global domains
key_findings.access_error_rule_names: Failing rule names shown only to users with base.group_no_one AND classified as internal users (debug mode gate)
key_findings.domain_validation: Domains validated at save time via safe_eval + Domain.validate; ValidationError raised on failure
